description: Discover AWS Batch job definitions and materialize one asset per job definition by submitting a real AWS Batch job through Dagster Pipes (this component's own PipesBatchClient, modeled on dagster_aws.pipes.PipesECSClient), polling DescribeJobs to completion.

outputs.description: One asset per AWS Batch job definition, materialized via the job's own PipesContext.report_asset_materialization().

region_name.label: Region Name
region_name.description: AWS region for the batch/logs clients.

job_queue.label: Job Queue
job_queue.description: Default AWS Batch job queue jobs submit to. Per-entry override via assets_by_job_definition.<name>.job_queue.

job_definition_name_prefix.label: Job Definition Name Prefix
job_definition_name_prefix.description: Only include job definitions whose name starts with this prefix.

exclude_job_definitions.label: Exclude Job Definitions
exclude_job_definitions.description: Explicit list of job definition names to skip.

filter_by_name_pattern.label: Filter By Name Pattern
filter_by_name_pattern.description: Regex -- only include job definitions whose name matches.

exclude_name_pattern.label: Exclude Name Pattern
exclude_name_pattern.description: Regex -- exclude job definitions whose name matches.

container_environment.label: Container Environment
container_environment.description: Environment variable overrides for the container, as a plain {name: value} dict -- converted internally to Batch's [{name, value}] list shape.

retry_attempts.label: Retry Attempts
retry_attempts.description: retryStrategy.attempts -- number of times Batch itself retries a failed job.

submit_job_params_overrides.label: Submit Job Params Overrides
submit_job_params_overrides.description: Raw overrides deep-merged on top of the submit_job params this component builds, for anything not covered by an explicit field above.

log_group.label: Log Group
log_group.description: Fallback CloudWatch log group when a job definition's own logConfiguration doesn't specify one. Batch's real default is 'aws/batch/job' (used when this is unset).

extras.label: Extras
extras.description: Arbitrary extra data passed to PipesBatchClient.run(extras=...).

poll_interval_seconds.label: Poll Interval Seconds
poll_interval_seconds.description: Seconds between DescribeJobs polls (Batch's boto3 client ships no completion waiter).

assets_by_job_definition.label: Assets By Job Definition
assets_by_job_definition.description: Override the asset spec (and job_queue/container_environment) for specific job definitions, keyed by job definition name.

translation.label: Translation
translation.description: Optional per-asset translation callable. Receives a BatchJobDefinitionProps and returns a dict of AssetSpec kwargs.

key_prefix.label: Key Prefix
key_prefix.description: Prefix for every emitted asset key. Default: ['aws_batch'].

demo_mode.label: Demo Mode
demo_mode.description: Run jobs as a real local subprocess against fake Batch/CloudWatch clients instead of a real AWS Batch job queue. The real PipesBatchClient/PipesCloudWatchMessageReader code runs unmodified in both modes -- only the boto3 API calls are faked. Set false for real AWS Batch.

local_script_path.label: Local Script Path
local_script_path.description: Script demo mode launches locally (via sys.executable) in place of a real Batch job. Required when demo_mode=true.

generate_sensor.label: Generate Sensor
generate_sensor.description: Opt-in sensor polling ListJobs for jobs Dagster did not itself submit (no dagster/run-id tag).

observation_interval_seconds.label: Observation Interval Seconds
observation_interval_seconds.description: Sensor tick interval. Only used when generate_sensor=true.

job_queues_to_poll.label: Job Queues To Poll
job_queues_to_poll.description: Job queues the observation sensor polls via ListJobs. Default: [job_queue].

partition_type.label: Partition Type
partition_type.description: Applied to every job definition's asset.

backfill_policy.label: Backfill Policy
backfill_policy.description: Only honored when the asset is actually partitioned.

backfill_policy_max_partitions_per_run.label: Backfill Policy Max Partitions Per Run

name: AWS Batch Workspace
